title: Umutwaro w'impano yanzwe
intro: Mu ntangiriro z'amateka y'abantu, igihe isi yari ikiri nto kandi isi yari ifite umwuka wayo wa mbere, hari umuntu wahagaze imbere y'Umuremyi afite igitambo cyicisha bugufi. Icyo gitambo cyapimwe mu rugero rwo kwemerwa n'Imana - kandi cyabonetse ko kidafite akamaro. Icyakurikiyeho si inkuru y'imbabazi, ahubwo ni umutima wuzuye ishyari, bigatuma habaho igikorwa kidasubirwaho cyashoboraga kugaruka mu bihe byose. Iyi ni inkuru y'umuntu waje kuvugwaho akarengane ka mbere gakomeye kabayeho.
clues: Navutse ndi umwe mu bana ba mbere bavutse, navukiye ku mubyeyi uzi neza inkuru ye.
Nigeze gutura Imana igitambo, ariko sinacyakira — nubwo igitambo cya murumuna wanjye cyakiriwe neza.
Ishyari n'umujinya byarashinze imizi mu mutima wanjye, maze ntera ubwoba ko nzahitana ubuzima bw'abavandimwe banjye.
Umuvandimwe wanjye yambwiye ko ngomba gutinya Imana, ariko ishema ryanjye ntiryanyemerera kumva.
Mu gihe cy'intege nke zikabije, nakoreye umuvandimwe wanjye igikorwa kidasanzwe.
Nyuma yaho, sinari nzi no guhisha ibyo nakoze — kugeza ubwo ikiremwa cyo mu isi cyoherejwe kunyigisha.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
